definitions.gloss: cohabitation, living together (as an unmarried couple)
definitions.explanation: An unmarried romantic couple sharing a residence. In Japanese society, this term specifically implies a romantic partnership rather than simply being roommates.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}は{同棲|どうせい}を{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: The two of them started living together.

examples.japanese: {結婚|けっこん}{前|まえ}に{同棲|どうせい}するカップルが{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: More and more couples are living together before getting married.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}と{同棲|どうせい}して{初|はじ}めて、{生活|せいかつ}{習慣|しゅうかん}の{違|ちが}いに{気|き}づいた。
examples.english: It wasn't until I moved in with my girlfriend that I noticed the differences in our daily habits.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{同棲|どうせい}を{始|はじ}める (start living together)
・{同棲|どうせい}{生活|せいかつ} (life of cohabitation)
・{同棲|どうせい}{相手|あいて} (live-in partner)
・{同棲|どうせい}を{解消|かいしょう}する (end cohabitation, move out)

While becoming more socially accepted, cohabitation before marriage still carries some stigma in traditional contexts in Japan. The word specifically implies a romantic relationship — for non-romantic shared living, {同居|どうきょ} or ルームシェア is used instead.
